protocol.rule: Compare the original releases through 40,000 updates on Screen1_1 for seeds 22 and 251. Set both optimizers' smoothing to 0.0061 for the three matched formulations. Train only the adjusted EMPF fits, reuse the other four configurations and replay all five pilot curves through 3,600 on identical inputs. Compare the paired endpoints and the time-weighted mean from 30,000 to 40,000 updates regardless of earlier rankings.
